Who We Are

Kelompok Studi Pasar Modal

KSPM FEB UB membangun pemahaman pasar modal di lingkungan kampus. Di bawah, peta KPI memperlihatkan bagaimana tiap departemen bergerak.

Vision

To make KSPM FEB UB an organization that accommodates and develops student interest in the capital market sector to produce excellent young investors, as well as become an active contributor to capital market literacy within the university environment and the wider community.

Mission
1

Developing functional competence by providing theoretical and practical education in a structured and sustainable manner.

2

Providing a platform and organizing open, accessible, and relevant basic capital market education programs for all FEB UB students, in order to develop interest in investment.

3

Establishing and strengthening strategic partnership with organizations, institutions, and individuals relevant to the capital market in an effort to enhance organizational capacity.

4

Actively contributing as a capital market literacy educator through organizing educational activities that have a positive impact on the wider community.

Catatan

Sumber data dan cara membaca

Dari mana data KPI berasal?

Data dibaca dari file KPI Tracker Department. Skor departemen mengikuti kolom Department KPI di Excel dan tidak dihitung ulang di halaman ini.

Mengapa ada departemen dengan skor rendah?

Indikator yang belum diisi dihitung nol, jadi departemen dengan banyak data kosong tampak rendah. Angka di atas 100% menunjukkan capaian melampaui target.

Bagaimana peta dibaca?

Enam departemen digambarkan sebagai enam benua. Tinggi benua mengikuti metrik yang dipilih, dan warnanya menunjukkan skor KPI. Pemetaan departemen ke benua bersifat ilustrasi.

Dari mana bentuk benua diambil?

Garis pantai benua berasal dari data Natural Earth (domain publik), diproyeksikan dengan proyeksi Natural Earth. Wilayah Rusia di timur Pegunungan Ural dihitung ke Asia.
